workerC_summary.joint_ladder_statement_draft: Five pushes, dose-response 0.1363 -> 0.18671875 -> 0.18984375 -> 0.191796875 -> 0.192578125 -> 0.193359375 -> 0.194140625. Time (392 Arm T): spent. 12-mode widening (392 R-W): paid once, winner interior — spent. Modes (408 Arm A): paid once finished (+0.00078125, at a thin 6.8x floor margin). The 16-mode c-idx-0 widening (416 Arm A): paid ZERO at home — the arm best is its own seed A-6 at its standing level; that lever is SPENT. The combination (408 Arm B capped + 416 Arm B resumption): paid a further full rung (+0.00078125 over A-6, +0.0015625 over RW-5) when allowed to converge, and paid it at FAT margins (91-95x floor) — convergence time on the combination is the one lever that still pays at the full historical increment with slack restored. No winner of this phase sits on any box bound (named best B-4 has no bound-sitter within 0.01; nearest coordinate c idx 13 at 0.0198 interior), and the D-416-1 diagnostic (clip-free Arm A lineage: all idx 13 interior, -2.026..-2.164) removes idx 13 from the price list — the named-coordinate widening programme is SPENT: no unpriced bound-sitter remains. The ceiling-setter is unchanged (inner-ramp SEC, r=3.75) and the flux wall has not moved (q_max 0.989-0.997 at the new ceilings; both Type-I-only walls of this phase are distinct directional structure, flux clause not arrived). Judgement: the ladder reads STILL OPEN on exactly one lever — further convergence of the combination population — and SPENT on every coordinate-widening lever so far named. The increments have held at one screening rung per finished push for three consecutive pushes; whether a fourth rung exists is a question for convergence time, not for a wider box.
